task: Core #1272: enforce scoped and sourced accepted PO decision authority in the existing Plan Before Code path

assuranceCeiling.rationale: High assurance is required because a mistaken PO rule could block unrelated development or silently reintroduce a Pro-only entitlement, an optional security update, or a lower-fidelity visual reference. The change remains inside the existing Atlas / PO Instruction Authority / Plan Before Code quality system, does not modify storefront runtime, tenant data, providers or production. Exact-head adversarial scoped and unrelated-scope evidence is mandatory before any verified-complete claim.

acceptanceCriteria: The canonical PO Instruction Authority validates four authoritative scoped decisions: Module 4 baseline B2B/RFQ, Module 8.5 full E7 Alap+Pro, Module 8.9 Release Alap+Pro with advanced P&L Pro, Module 9.6/A centrally mandatory Core updates.

Every activated decision retains stable source/identity, later explicit supersession precedence, bounded scope and a falsifiable forbidden plan state; verbatim-unverified M2.18–2.19 and rejected M9.7 are not activated.

The existing Plan Before Code path blocks wrong package entitlement or mandatory-update opt-out plans at relevant scope, including paraphrased plan intentions, without relying only on a literal string in source files.
All sixteen recorded positive, negative, unknown-source and unrelated-change cases execute against the exact implementation head with the expected per-case disposition.
Existing shipping-and-payment separation instruction and known failure / negative-knowledge / tenant boundaries continue to pass regression checks.
Core-first roadmap dependency and closed U11/B transaction remain unchanged; no new engine, paid provider, active database change or unsafe release.
The exact-head plan, CI, Completion Truth and lifecycle proof must be separately reported; no documentation-only evidence is promoted as functional success.
invariants: The Product Owner-approved GitHub issue is normative, and later explicit scope-specific decisions override earlier generic packaging narratives.
No private raw chat transcript or credentials are copied into public GitHub files; historical index provenance is supplementary, not a new PO authority.
Affected file and plan-domain scoping must fail closed when relevant authority is unresolved, but leave unrelated documentation and other capabilities undisturbed.
The existing PO instruction registry, Atlas semantic route and Plan Before Code validator remain the sole shared execution authority.
Client, admin and server-side capability paths may never assert unsupported completion from a plan acknowledgement or text-only source scan.
The new development plan has the current main base SHA, matching PR transaction identity, and is independent from the closed Core 1186 U11/B plan.
forbiddenStates: A proposed E7 Compare & Spec plan restricts the full accepted engine to Pro only.
A proposed Release/Drop plan wrongly makes basic Release Pro only or includes Pro-only analytical finance in Alap.
A proposed plan removes Alap basic B2B partner RFQ rights because of an older general Pro-only note.
A proposed plan grants merchants indefinite opt-out from centrally required shared Core security updates.
A Builder limitation silently rewrites a PO-approved visual reference without explicit new PO approval.
A missing M2.18–2.19 original conversation or rejected M9.7 is converted into a fabricated accepted runtime instruction.
The Plan Before Code reports PASS on an incomplete source or on a scoped contradictory instruction without a meaningful negative test.
The new PO rule blocks unrelated docs-only changes, rewrites the older U11/B plan to forge CI identity, or introduces a parallel gate engine.

failureModes: Source type confusion treats ChatGPT paraphrase as normative acceptance and creates a false positive rule.
Generic pre-2026 package labeling overrides later explicit accepted E7 or Release rights.
Substring-only forbiddenState matching misses semantic plan contradictions expressed with different words.
Overbroad affectedPatterns make every editing operation trigger unrelated PO rules.
Plan acknowledgement is accepted without checking forbidden states or exact PO source mapping.
Canonical Atlas no longer resolves a source-independent scope after a stale CI base or changed file classification.
New rules accidentally permit tenant security patch opt-out or unsafe operational bypass.
Historical U11/B plan is reused and masks the #1272 transaction base mismatch.
edgeCases: Merchants retain Alap E7 comparison while advanced E8 context profile stays Pro-only.
Alap Release remains available; advanced finance analysis is Pro and cannot leak through client-only gating.
Basic B2B/RFQ is Alap+Pro although Pro has advanced approval, workflow and pricing limits.
Unrelated docs spelling-only diff must not match the business domain rule.
A plan requests Pro-only entitlement without using the literal phrase Pro-only.
An affected capability plan omits known authoritative source despite listing correct files.
PO decision M9.7 is explicitly not accepted and M2.18–2.19 verbatim text remains source-unknown.
A stale branch / unrelated local code path produces false positives or false-green derived from an old Atlas.

alternatives.summary: Extend the existing canonical PO Instruction Registry, Atlas semantic source mapping and Plan Before Code route with normalized scoped decision claims and negative tests.
alternatives.reason: One machine authority, reuse known-failure selection and transaction proof, preserve no-duplicate-engine rule.

alternatives.summary: Build an independent prose-only PO consistency checker and run it in parallel in CI.
alternatives.reason: Duplicates existing authority, creates divergent source and scope semantics and risks false-green contradictions.

alternatives.summary: Activate every historical provenance index record immediately as a blocking PO instruction.
alternatives.reason: Several sources are partial, old generic rules are superseded, some decisions not accepted, and the existing scanner is literal-only.

specialistReviews.finding: Existing Atlas computes affected file patterns and PO instructions and already exposes execution-route authority; a second validator would diverge.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use the existing registry and Plan Before Code, add bounded source context and targeted plan contradiction checks only.

specialistReviews.finding: A blanket auto-import of unverified historical messages could promote unapproved rules or unexpectedly disable production-safe tenant workflows.
specialistReviews.resolution: Limit active machine rules to four verified accepted PO decisions and treat missing or explicitly rejected sources as non-authorizing review states.

specialistReviews.finding: Fail-open semantic scope and standalone rule engines risk previously registered SQ-KF-001, SQ-KF-013 and SQ-KF-022 recurrence.
specialistReviews.resolution: Preserve existing Development Guard scope, test unchanged instructions and reject unknown scoped authority before marking feature complete.

challenge.scenario: A future E7 PR restates an earlier Pro-only package classification.
challenge.finding: Latest explicit M8.5 Alap+Pro decision can be silently lost.
challenge.resolution: Attach current PO issue and supersession precedence and require one negative and one positive plan proof.

challenge.scenario: A proposed plan uses 'premium customers only' without the literal word 'Pro'.
challenge.finding: Existing forbidden-state substring scan is insufficient to prove plan intent contradiction.
challenge.resolution: Use bounded structured decision claims and adversarial paraphrase fixtures alongside existing file state checks.

challenge.scenario: Every changed file is treated as matching the entire accepted decision registry.
challenge.finding: False-positive blocks stop unrelated fixes and promote new cost overhead.
challenge.resolution: Map source decisions to canonical affected domain and planned file patterns, include unrelated-docs negative control.

challenge.scenario: A raw conversation summary lacks exact original M2.18/M2.19 wording.
challenge.finding: Completing guessed requirements would fabricate Product Owner acceptance.
challenge.resolution: Keep source status UNKNOWN and require explicit source reconciliation before implementing that subpoint.

challenge.scenario: A future tenant asks to remain on a vulnerable old Core version.
challenge.finding: Optionality contradicts accepted M9.6/A centrally mandatory update rule.
challenge.resolution: Explicitly encode mandatory central update with compatibility validation and block indefinite opt-out claims.

challenge.scenario: A clean docs-only branch inherits the previous closed U11/B transaction base SHA.
challenge.finding: Exact-head GitHub CI blocks before tests, tempting a bypass.
challenge.resolution: Create new scoped plan derived from native Development Guard, bind its base to current main, preserve U11/B closure.

challenge.scenario: The builder reference is weakened just to satisfy current editor capabilities.
challenge.finding: A historical visual authority is overturned without Product Owner approval.
challenge.resolution: Keep canonical Visual First precedence and scope any new rule to design implementation without spawning extra Builder features.

challenge.scenario: A CI PASS is treated as proof that all 108 historical decisions are executable.
challenge.finding: A narrow source and test scope is overclaimed as complete knowledge archival.
challenge.resolution: Keep claim scope limited to four verified decisions, 16 tested fixtures and existing guard reuse, leaving unresolved sources explicit.

proofPlan: Retain native exact-head GitHub Actions Development Guard PASS #38377811666, source SHA b29742128abbf2dc36775be4bdd97725f8cb81a3, for the planned file list only; inspect full 29.9 KB guard directive report and build fresh task-specific plan.
Run Plan Before Code --check on a branch rooted at exact current main SHA 6023c0e9c596b2533360dc98ed83d16a7bcbfe54 after storing this plan; do not make implementation edits before gate PASS.
Add four canonical scope-limited active PO decision instructions with exact #1259/#1269/#1271 source identity and explicit precedence; never activate uncertain source rows.
Extend semantic Plan Before Code contradiction assertion using existing authority imports and structured plan claims, without a duplicate controller or direct product-code changes.
Add and execute 16 exact-head cases: eight BLOCK, six PASS, one source-review and one unrelated/no-rule; include paraphrase bypass and prior shipping/payment regression tests.
Run edit-time guard and incremental replay after coherent edits; follow required knowledge, release risk, test, typecheck, build, Truth Gate and lifecycle on the exact branch SHA.
Treat GitHub Actions checkout as only an execution environment: do not claim that its successful checkout or a passed Development Guard validates an unfinished implementation.

requirements.requirement: Precisely four normative, accepted PO decisions are represented with stable source, scope, precedence and forbidden outcomes in the existing shared authority.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Reject nonaccepted 9.7 and verbatim-unverified M2.18/M2.19 as automatically active decisions.

requirements.requirement: Existing Plan Before Code refuses scoped contradictory entitlement and Core update opt-out claims while preserving authorized cases.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A scoped contradictory plan must not pass by mere PO instruction acknowledgement.

requirements.requirement: All sixteen recorded positive/negative/unknown/unrelated PO scenarios are executed and independently match their expected dispositions.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Unrelated documentation must not trigger a business entitlement rule or bypass an actual relevant one.
